verses.text: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
The foot shall tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.”
The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.
The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, Yahweh.
We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

footnotes.content: A song for the day when God's salvation becomes the city's true defense. Not walls of stone, but trust in Him—that's the fortress that holds.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Open gates, but only for the faithful. The Lord welcomes the righteous inside because they have learned to keep faith with Him. Trust is the password home.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: "Perfect peace"—shalom tamim—for the mind stayed on Him. I've seen this. When the heart won't let go of His hand, the noise of the world fades to a hush.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Forever, and forever. An everlasting Rock—not shifting sand beneath us, but the God who outlasts kingdoms and centuries. Trust Him and you rest on something that cannot crumble.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Pride goes before the fall. The high walls of the proud, the cities built on boasting—He brings them low. It's an ancient pattern: He delights to humble the arrogant.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Even the poor walk over those fallen walls. When the proud are brought to dust, it levels everything—and the weak find dignity treading over what once crushed them.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: The righteous walk a smooth path, and we who follow help make it clear for others. Our uprightness is like stone smoothed by faithful feet, showing the way.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: In the darkness of waiting, we keep our eyes on Him. His name, His renown—that's what the soul hungers for, more than relief or comfort. The longing itself is prayer.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Soul and spirit together, awake in the night, seeking Him earnestly. When His judgments fall on the earth, the world learns righteousness only because someone has already held fast to Him in the darkness.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Mercy shown to the wicked, yet they will not change. Some hearts are so bent on their own way that even kindness cannot turn them. This is the sorrow of heaven—grace refused.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: His hand is lifted, His zeal burns for His people—yet the blind don't see it coming. But fire will consume His enemies. There is both tenderness and terrible justice in His heart.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: "You have done all our work for us." What peace—not by our striving, but by His. He ordains the peace and accomplishes the salvation. We rest in His finished work.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Other lords may have ruled us for a time, but they have no claim on the Name we speak. His alone. Our mouth confesses Him, our hearts bow to Him—that's freedom.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: The dead shall not live again—those spirits who defied Him are gone. God does not restore to life those who have chosen death. His judgment is both certain and final.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: You increased the nation, O Lord—twice He says it, as if marveling. From a small faithful remnant, a people emerges, and all the earth knows His glory. This is His way: small seeds grow into a forest.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: In trouble they came to Him, pouring out their prayers. His chastening, though hard, drove them to His door. Sometimes love disciplines because it knows the only help is Him.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: The labor pains of a woman about to deliver—that's the image for Israel's struggle before salvation. The pain is real, but it means new life is about to break through.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: We gave birth only to wind. We toiled, we suffered—and nothing of our own strength saved us. This is the bitter confession of those who tried everything except His way first.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Readers today hear an echo: Your dead shall live. Not just figuratively, but the promise of resurrection morning when dew falls on the dust and the earth gives up her beloved. Christ is the firstfruits of that awakening.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: Enter your rooms, close the doors, hide yourself for a moment. Like a child waiting safe while the storm passes outside—trust that He will shelter you through the indignation to come.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight

footnotes.content: He comes out of His place to punish iniquity. The earth herself will reveal what was hidden, will no longer hide the slain. Justice is coming—and with it, mercy for His own.
footnotes.author: LLT Insight
